## CFA 01 – Feedback Processor
Receives customer feedback payloads via webhook, validates inputs and screens spam honeypots, retrieves existing issue groups from Google Sheets, runs Gemini AI classification and fuzzy clustering, records tagged feedback in Google Sheets, and dispatches real-time Telegram alerts for angry customers.

parameters.text: ={{ '🚨 Angry customer alert Source: ' + $('Parse Tags').first().json.source + ' Customer: ' + ($('Parse Tags').first().json.customer_name || 'Anonymous') + ' ' + ($('Parse Tags').first().json.customer_email || '') + ' Rating: ' + ($('Parse Tags').first().json.rating || 'n/a') + ' Score: ' + $('Parse Tags').first().json.sentiment_score + ' Issue: ' + $('Parse Tags').first().json.issue_group + ' "' + ($('Parse Tags').first().json.comment || '').slice(0, 500).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>') + '"' }}
